title.zh: 修订并废止第1411号共和国法中关于保和省公共工程项目的若干项目的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend and Repeal Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven, Regarding Public Works Projects for the Province of Bohol
title.orig: An Act to Amend and Repeal Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven, Regarding Public Works Projects for the Province of Bohol

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1470_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Items seventy-six to eighty-seven, paragraph II, subsection h, for the Province of Bohol, section three of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, are amended to read as follows:
"76. Home Economics Building, Inabanga Central Elementary School, Inabanga- Repair ₱1,500.00 "77. Inabanga Central Elementary School Building, Inabanga— Repair 3,000.00 "78. U-og Intermediate School Building, Inabanga- Reconstruction 3,000.00 "79. Liloan Norte Barrio School Building, Inabanga— Reconstruction 3,000.00 "80. Liloan Sur Barrio School Building, Inabanga— Completion 2,500.00 "81. Badiang Barrio School Building, Inabanga— Completion 2,500.00 "82. Cambuhat Barrio School Building, Inabanga— Completion 2,500.00 "83. Baogo Barrio School Building, Inabanga— Completion 2,000.00" "84. Magtangatang Barrio School Building, Inabanga— Completion 3,000.00 "85. Dagohoy Barrio School Building, Inabanga— Construction 3,000.00 "86. Cahayag Primary School Building, Tubigon— Construction, including the acquisition of school site 5,000.00 "87. Daet Norte Barrio School Building, Inabanga— Completion 2,000.00"
Items eighty-eight to one hundred four, paragraph II, subsection h, for the Province of Bohol, section three of the same Act, are repealed.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
